label: For "Fibre Fault Localisation from OTDR & Telemetry": Locate the position of a fibre cut or degradation from OTDR traces and optical telemetry so repair crews go to the right place the first time. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Using estimated locations as labels.
